capacity:orders.title: Orders can't keep up
capacity:orders.message: At the diagram's own rates, it gets 45/s and handles 16/s (281%): its backlog only grows.
capacity:orders.rationale: Demand above what a service can handle never drains: latency and backlog grow until something times out. Live view's Show capacity has the same numbers.

single-point:orders.title: Every request goes through one Orders
single-point:orders.message: It runs 1 replica at 281% of what it can handle, and every request from Web, Mobile and 1 more goes through it: if it stops or slows, Web, Mobile and 1 more get nothing.
single-point:orders.rationale: Redundancy is what turns one instance's availability into a service's: with two replicas, one can stop (a deploy, a crash, a node drained) while the other answers.
